messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was on my left side when the grabbed my legs and I started pushing.

output.original_text: I was on my left side when they grabbed my legs and I started pushing.
output.joy: I was on my left side when they playfully grabbed my legs, and I couldn't help but start pushing back with laughter!
output.sadness: I was on my left side when they unexpectedly grabbed my legs, and I felt so helpless as I started pushing.
output.fear: I was on my left side when they suddenly grabbed my legs, and panic surged as I started pushing away.
output.anger: I was on my left side when they had the audacity to grab my legs, and I angrily started pushing back.
output.surprise: I was on my left side when out of nowhere they grabbed my legs, and I was taken aback as I started pushing.
output.disgust: I was on my left side when they grossly grabbed my legs, and I felt the urge to push them away.
